Title: Krishikesh K on Instagram: "10 accelerators that will fund a seed-stage startup in 2026. What they give, what they take, where to apply.

I get asked this every week, so here it is in one place.

Y Combinator puts in $500K. Techstars $220K. 500 Global $150K. SOSV $250K for hard tech and bio. Berkeley SkyDeck $210K. Entrepreneur First up to $250K, and Antler will take you before you even have a co-founder.

Two of them take zero equity. Plug and Play runs corporate programs with no cost to join. MassChallenge pays cash prizes instead of buying shares.

The mistake most founders make is applying to all ten. Pick three.

If you’re pre-idea, it’s Antler or EF. If you have a product, it’s YC, Techstars or SkyDeck. If you’re B2B, Alchemist. If you’re building hardware or biotech, SOSV. If you don’t want to give up equity yet, Plug and Play or MassChallenge.

One thing to check before you apply: YC now only invests in companies incorporated in the US, Cayman or Singapore. If you’re incorporated elsewhere, plan the flip first.

Terms change every year. Every slide has the URL. Go read the current deal before you hit submit.

Save this. Send it to the founder who’s raising right now.

#startupaccelerator #ycombinator #techstars #seedfunding"
